Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution o  India, praying this Court to issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the  respondent forthwith to refer the representation dated 21.07.2025  submitted by the petitioners for enhancement of compensation under section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in La  Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 with respect   the acquired lands comprised in Survey No. 591 admeasuring 3.80 acr  situated at Chitharchathiram village, Manur Taluk, Tirunelveli Dist  respect of which Award No. 44/2025 in Na.Ka.A2/265/2022 dated  20.03.2025 was passed by the second respondent.
 For Petitioner : Mr. R.Ponkarthi  For Respondents : Mr.M.Muthu Mani  Government Advo  ORDER

The petitioner seeks enhancement of compensation in relation to Award No.44 of 2025 dated 20.03.2025.
2.
The petitioners state that the compensation was fixed at Rs.3,80,000/- per acre in respect of 3.80 acres owned by them in Survey No.591, Chitharchathiram village, Manur Taluk, Tirunelveli District.

By asserting that compensation was paid at Rs.8,00,000/- per acre in relation to the adjacent land,
the petitioner had requested for enhancement of the https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis ( Uploaded on: 10/09/2025 07:40:19 pm ) W.P(MD)NO.24042 of 2025 compensation by way of reference under Section 64 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition Rehabilitation and Resettlement Act, 2013 (2013 Act).

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate accepts notice for the respondents.

He has placed on record the order issued by the second respondent to the effect that the petitioners failed to participate in the enquiry and that, therefore, it is not possible to accept the request for payment of Rs.8,00,000/- per acre.
4. The communication dated 24.07.2024 from the second respondent records that the compensation was fixed at Rs.8,00,000/- in relation to the adjacent land after negotiations.
In the circumstatances, it is just and reasonable that the petitioners' request for enhanced compensation be considered by the first respondent.
